About.title: About
paragraphs: I'm Helong Zhou, based in Guangzhou / Shenzhen, with 12 years in R&D. Frontend-grounded full-stack and architecture across admin systems, consumer products, cross-platform apps, infrastructure, and complex business platforms — strong at 0→1 delivery.
I've led cross-border payments, commerce, creator SaaS, and AI site-building end to end (frontend, backend, data, cloud). I can also lead a small team on standards, review, and the critical path.
Recent focus: Next.js + TypeScript + Monorepo + AI Coding — putting generated code inside typing, verification, and CI/CD for shippable certainty.
